description.value: The study investigated functional activation during an n-back working-memory task and local grey matter volumes in detoxified alcohol-dependent patients and matched healthy controls, including associations with prospective relapse risk.

spans.text: We combined analyses of neural activation during an n-back task and local grey matter volumes using Biological Parametric Mapping in 40 detoxified alcohol-dependent patients and 40 matched healthy controls (HC), and assessed prospective relapse risk during a 7-month follow-up period.

description.value: Observational case-control study with prospective follow-up of alcohol-dependent patients after detoxification.
